sloka: ततः काले महाबाहुर्बलेन महतावृतः ।प्रस्थितः पुरतो धन्वी लङ्कामभिमुखः पुरीम् ।। ६.४१.२५ ।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ kāle mahābāhurbalena mahatāvṛtaḥ ।prasthitaḥ purato dhanvī laṅkāmabhimukhaḥ purīm ।। 6.41.25 ।।।।

translations.english: Raghava, who is knowledgeable of when to do what, motivated the army of Vanaras and Sugriva and ordered.
